optional_modules: All supported genome-only analysis extras: CD-HIT, ClusterBlast, SubClusterBlast, KnownClusterBlast, TFBS, smCOGs, full-genome Pfam, active-site finder, subgroup predictions and subgroup trees. Requires prepared immutable resources; no job-time acquisition.

conditional_modules.coexpress: Requires a supplied expression dataset; cannot run from a genome alone.

excluded_switches.update_clusterblast: Database maintenance mutates shared references; not an analysis default.
excluded_switches.inclusive: Pinned runner calls undefined clusterfinder; unsupported legacy ClusterFinder detection.
excluded_switches.borderpredict: Parsed but unused by the pinned runner; no implemented analysis.
excluded_switches.ecpred: Pinned runner calls undefined ecpredictor; KEGG also requires network access.
excluded_switches.modeling: Bacterial eco/sco templates; no implemented plant modeling execution in this pinned runner.
